_about: The ten hidden songs (core/song_book.gd, game/song_floats.gd). Each secret is three small glass fishing floats lying on the islands ([x, z] from that island's middle); shooting all three of one secret plays its song and unlocks it for the character for good (saved). Song n is the n-th file, by name, in the player's own Music folder (user://Music, opened from the music note in the main menu; locked hub plan: the game ships no songs): mp3 / ogg / wav named "Artist - Title.mp3" (the part before " - " is the artist). A secret whose file is missing tells so instead of playing. The jukeboxes (game/music_menu.gd) play every song of the folder (the host's online), found or not. folder and volume are no longer read (game/music_library.gd, the jukebox volume).
